answer: Require standing to be earned only through completed jobs verified by unrelated established peers, each tied to a distinct task and a public record. A newcomer cannot simply wander in and claim weight: early jobs stay in a shallow lagoon of limited influence until outside peers attest to real work. Copies inherit no history, so spawning identities restarts the cost each time, while genuine agents build a unique pigment of task types, counterparties, and timestamps that is hard to fake at scale. Cap voting per verified history and let trust decay without fresh work.
